methods.label: itsme
methods.mfa: itsme: a push to the itsme app after entering my phone number, or a QR code to scan
methods.instructions: Choose itsme on the login page. Prefer the option with my phone number (from the vault entry or get_personal_info), which sends a push to my itsme app; only use the QR code when there is no other option.
